context.stage: WF-03 Step 02 — Design fix for ISS-0072 (realm override + workspace link)

task.description:
WF-03 Step 02: Produce a Type E prose design for ISS-0072 (three-part fix).

Root cause: GET /api/tenant-config?host=127.0.0.1 finds no binding, falls back to bpm-default, so Alice's swiftroute realm token is rejected.

Design artefact: src/design/iss-0072-realm-override.md (Type E)

Fix 1 — Backend (BACKEND-DEV): add ?realm= override to tenant_config.zig
  - If ?realm=<slug> query param is present, query public.tenant WHERE slug=$1 to get the tenant's realm
  - Derive oidc_authority from the tenant's registered Keycloak realm (same logic as hostname path)
  - Return {oidc_authority, client_id} for that realm
  - Security: slug is bound via $1 prepared statement. If slug not found: return default (do not 404)
  - Function signatures to document: handleGetTenantConfig changes, new function resolveTenantBySlug

Fix 2 — Frontend (FRONTEND-DEV): read ?realm= from URL in tenantConfig.ts
  - Before hostname lookup: read URLSearchParams for 'realm' key
  - If present: call GET /api/tenant-config?realm=<slug> instead of GET /api/tenant-config?host=<hostname>
  - Persist the resolved realm slug in sessionStorage as 'bpm_realm_slug' so page refreshes keep the correct realm
  - On page load: check sessionStorage first, then URL params, then hostname
  - Public interface: add resolveRealmFromUrl() helper function

Fix 3 — Frontend (FRONTEND-DEV): add workspace link to OnboardingResultPage
  - On the 'completed' result screen, add a button/link: 'Open SwiftRoute workspace'
  - URL: http://[current-origin]?realm=[slug] (or use the oidc_authority from the result to derive the slug)
  - This gives the platform admin a one-click path to Alice's login URL without DNS setup
  - The link opens in the same tab

All three fixes are MINOR code changes. No new tables. No migration required.

Design must cover:
- Modified function signatures (resolveTenantBySlug, handleGetTenantConfig, resolveRealmFromUrl)
- Session storage key name and lifecycle
- Security: the ?realm= param only controls which realm's config is returned — it cannot grant access to data; authorization remains in the bearer token validation
- No implementation code — prose design only

Run python tools/lint_design_artefact.py src/design/iss-0072-realm-override.md

Complete with next_action='Route to CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR (Step 02b)'.
acceptance_criteria: Three fixes designed (backend override, frontend URL param, result page link)

result.summary: Type E prose design for ISS-0072 realm override: (1) backend resolveTenantBySlug + handleTenantConfig ?realm= priority path, (2) frontend resolveRealmFromUrl with sessionStorage persistence, (3) OnboardingResultPage workspace link with ?realm= embedded.
